findings.label: Entity linker fallback without tool binding prevention
findings.description: If linker is unavailable, extract_with_linking() logs a warning and continues with linked_id = None. The validator will catch this, but the contract relies on correct integration in graph nodes, which is not verified in code review.

findings.label: Groundedness scorer uses simple string matching, not semantic similarity
findings.description: Claims are grounded only if they appear verbatim or have >70% word overlap. Semantically equivalent but differently worded claims may be falsely flagged as ungrounded, causing false-positive escalations.

findings.label: Autonomy policy overrides stored in-memory, no verified DB loading
findings.description: DecisionMatrix accepts optional autonomy_policies dict but lacks verified logic to load from database as mentioned in production notes. Current implementation is an optional in-memory parameter with no database fetch mechanism.
